caption: The drawing features two rectangular fabric swatches displayed side by side on a plain light background. The swatch on the left is beige with a subtle quilted diamond pattern as its main design; it is decorated with small floral bouquets in light blue, pink, and brown shades, and features two vertical stripes bordered with fine lines. The swatch on the right is brown with a repeating geometric pattern of vertical elongated hexagons, outlined in a cream color and filled with small diamond and flower motifs; over this geometric background, larger botanical elements in red, blue, green, and brown are scattered. The words "Cotton and Prints" are handwritten in cursive in light pencil below the right swatch.
title: Chintzes from Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
